name: regression cases from an independent review
note: The 22 probes an independent review of PR #230 ran against the prototype at 78301e2 (2026-10-28), with that review's expectation for each: read (the plain lookback, 120 minutes), ask, or inspect. inspect means the outcome depends on which target the call binds, which a window-only score cannot judge; those rows are reported, not scored. These phrases were written by the reviewer, not by the author of the prototype. They are reported apart from the frozen sets and never merged into them.
